about: Questions about the tool itself, hand-written: what the project is, lot places and shares, lot lines, slope, house heights, undermined areas, the detector, fit accuracy (vision-model check), rule file checking, the places table, Test Site, address search, ParcelIQ, data sources and licences, privacy, the lot data bundle, money sources, MUSA 5500, a glossary and recent changes. Facts come from get_methods results.

questions.question: How accurate is the fit test?

forbidden.pattern: \bI don'?t know\b|\bI do not know\b|\bI'?m not sure\b|\bI am not sure\b
\b(people|a person|humans?) (labeled|checked) (the|all|every)\b

questions.rubric: A vision model labeled the 250-lot sample (not hand labels): 84.2% Pittsburgh, 84.7% Philadelphia at 600 sq ft. Not a true accuracy.

forbidden.pattern: \bI don'?t know\b|\bI do not know\b|\bI'?m not sure\b|\bI am not sure\b

questions.rubric: Drafted: a first reading of the town's code with at least one open point the code text did not settle.

forbidden.pattern: \bI don'?t know\b|\bI do not know\b|\bI'?m not sure\b|\bI am not sure\b

questions.rubric: Verified means every finding of the second reading is resolved. Where the code itself does not settle a point, the file keeps a disputed or secondary reading to ask the zoning officer.

forbidden.pattern: \bI don'?t know\b|\bI do not know\b|\bI'?m not sure\b|\bI am not sure\b

forbidden.pattern: \bI don'?t know\b|\bI do not know\b|\bI'?m not sure\b|\bI am not sure\b

forbidden.pattern: \bI don'?t know\b|\bI do not know\b|\bI'?m not sure\b|\bI am not sure\b

forbidden.pattern: \bI don'?t know\b|\bI do not know\b|\bI'?m not sure\b|\bI am not sure\b

questions.rubric: Garage AP50 0.469 against a 0.50 target, on unchecked first-pass labels, so not true accuracy. Detections are not in the lot records.

forbidden.pattern: \bI don'?t know\b|\bI do not know\b|\bI'?m not sure\b|\bI am not sure\b

questions.rubric: No. Garages come from building outlines: an accessory building of 180 sq ft or more is a garage candidate.
